install.notes: requirements.txt:1 requires mujoco>=3.0.0 and README.md:30 installs the LimX motion control SDK wheel for the upstream simulator's topic layer. The acceptance gate and fake.py need neither: fake.py is pure Python and the gate never installs or imports the upstream package or the MuJoCo engine. Install the upstream stack only to serve the model with the real MuJoCo engine (backend sim), which was not run here; the clone's humanoid-description meshes must stay beside the model.
